notable_absence.finding: The 'Index Replicas' advice recommends fixing the issue 'using the ALTER INDEX statement' - a direct reference to a SQL++ DDL statement mined in a prior batch (n1ql-language-reference), but this page does not restate or link to that statement's own privilege/edition gating. Treated as expected: this is advice-page framing ('use this statement to fix the problem'), not a definition of the statement itself, so no requiresPrivilege relation was forced onto it.

cross_component_finding: This is a genuine reference catalog (roughly 30 distinct advice types across Cluster/Index/Data/Node/Query/App Services/Search categories) with real - if modest - ontology content, unlike the pure compatibility tables in this batch (browser-compatibility.md, sdk-compatibility.md) and the raw-metric catalog (monitoring-reference.md). The storage-engine finding (Couchstore vs Magma resident-ratio thresholds) was not anticipated by this round's hypothesis (which asked specifically about a cloud-provider axis) but is an independent, equally well-evidenced case of the same generalization pattern: behavesDifferentlyUnder's range keeps growing new variant families (edition -> deployment:capella -> now storage-engine) each round a sufficiently detailed reference page is mined.
